title: Chrishell Stause Reveals Behind-the-Scenes Scoop On Tinashe Appearance On 'Selling Sunset' Season 8 <gwmw style="display: none; background-color: transparent;"></gwmw>
htmlContent:
With the eighth season of Netflix's Selling Sunset, the glamorous world of luxury real estate is returning. On Friday, September 6, Chrishell Stause, a leading star in the show, took to Instagram to celebrate the premiere. In her post, Chrishell shared some behind-the-scenes details about moments that didn't make the final cut, sparking excitement and controversy among fans.

Tinashe's Cut Cameo

According to Chrishell's Instagram post, Tinashe was featured in scenes left on the cutting room floor. Despite having filmed together throughout the season, fans were disappointed that Tinashe's sequences were not included in the final edit. Chrishell expressed her remorse, captioning a photo with Tinashe.

“These days of filming didn’t make it into season 8 of Selling Sunset, so I can post them now. Thank you @tinashenow for being amazing! Happy to help you anytime again. Was sad it wasn’t included.”

“They cut TINASHE out of the season over anything else?!?” Another wrote, “Tinashe is my FAVORITE and it would have been a fantasy to see her on Selling Sunset. What a disappointment!!”

Deshaun Watson's Controversial Cameo

The show's decision to include NFL quarterback Deshaun Watson as one of the affluent clients was met with criticism. Watson's appearance was not well-received by viewers due to multiple accusations of sexual misconduct. Many fans were shocked that the show chose to keep Watson's scenes while cutting others.

Viewers used social media to express their outrage.

“AND they kept in Deshaun Watson who had been accused of sexual assault by 30 women?!? My jaw dropped when he showed up,” one fan wrote. Another added, “They really fumbled this season,” Criticizing the show for focusing on Watson's storyline instead of more favorable moments.

Missing Personal Moments

In addition to Tinashe's cut scenes, Chrishell revealed that her moments with her partner, G Flip, were not included in the season. Fans eagerly awaited Chrishell's family life, particularly the conversations about starting a family with G Flip. Chrishell expressed gratitude to her partner for taking part in the show, writing, "Very sweet of you to film for me even though I know you don’t love it. I love you.”

Chrishell also mentioned a humorous moment involving her co-star Emma Hernan. Emma's scene by introducing her new partner to the cast was ultimately cut. Chrishell jokingly admitted she wasn’t a fan of Emma’s choice, suggesting that perhaps it was for the best that the scene didn’t make it to air.
